dsa-helper.aiProvider.description: Select AI Provider for generating note details and quiz questions.

dsa-helper.copilotModel.description: Copilot model family to use when Provider is set to 'copilot'.

dsa-helper.geminiApiKey.description: API Key for Google Gemini API (Required if Provider is 'gemini').

dsa-helper.ollamaUrl.description: Endpoint URL for local Ollama server (Required if Provider is 'ollama').

dsa-helper.ollamaModel.description: Ollama model name (e.g. llama3, mistral, qwen2.5-coder).

dsa-helper.customEndpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint URL (Required if Provider is 'custom').

dsa-helper.customApiKey.description: API Key for Custom OpenAI-compatible API.

dsa-helper.customModel.description: Model name for Custom API (e.g. gpt-4o, deepseek-chat, mistral-large).
